item.text: {"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence of arms-control, inspection, nonproliferation, disarmament, and de-escalation agreements involving Abiy Ahmed. I did not find any credible 2024 source showing Ethiopia entering a formal arms-control or nonproliferation treaty, or any nuclear-inspection arrangement. The evidence is mostly about ceasefire implementation, DDR, and regional de-escalation, not classic arms-control policy.","evidence":[{"title":"Ethiopia's leader plays down fears of conflict with Somalia over a planned naval port","publisher":"Associated Press via CityNews","date":"2024-02-06","url":"https://kitchener.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/","summary":"Abiy said he had “no intention” of going to war with Somalia and framed peace as mutually beneficial, while also trying to lower tensions around the Nile dam.
